top_papers.title: sciwrite-lint: Verification Infrastructure for the Age of Science Vibe-Writing
top_papers.abstract: Science currently offers two options for quality assurance, both inadequate. Journal gatekeeping claims to verify both integrity and contribution, but actually measures prestige: peer review is slow, biased, and misses fabricated citations even at top venues. Open science provides no quality assurance at all: the only filter between AI-generated text and the public record is the author's integrity. top_papers.title: What do Language Models Learn and When? The Implicit Curriculum Hypothesis
top_papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can perform remarkably complex tasks, yet the fine-grained details of how these capabilities emerge during pretraining remain poorly understood. top_papers.title: ClawBench: Can AI Agents Complete Everyday Online Tasks?
top_papers.abstract: AI agents may be able to automate your inbox, but can they automate other routine aspects of your life? Everyday online tasks offer a realistic yet unsolved testbed for evaluating the next generation of AI agents.
